name: 07 — Scenario "new enum variant" (v1 → v2 append-only enum, 2-node)
description:
Borsh encodes enums by discriminant INDEX (0, 1, 2, ...). Appending a new variant at the END of an existing enum preserves every pre-existing variant's index, so v1-encoded state bytes deserialize unchanged under v2 — no migration function is required. v1's `Status` has {Active=0, Paused=1}; v2's `Status` is {Active=0, Paused=1, Archived=2}. The upgrade is `upgrade_group(group=subgroup, target=v2)` (no caller-supplied method exists). Topology: namespace + one Open subgroup + one context in the subgroup.
Negative assertion: before the upgrade, the v2-only setter `set_status_archived` must NOT be callable (v1 doesn't export it). Post-upgrade, the implicit (non-migrating) decode preserves the v1 `Paused` status because its borsh index didn't shift, and the v2-only setter round-trips Archived from node 1 to node 2 (Phase 7d).
comment: Migrated from this file's v1 workflow by `merobox cloud port`.
Each of the original scenario's nodes is an account here; see merobox/cloud_v2/port.py for the mapping.
